intent: Loop charter: current contracts only, history archived
notes: The Gator Loop charter now states current contracts without their
provenance: issue tags, dates, milestone and checkpoint labels, measurement
dates and fix stories. Issue numbers that named a contract generation ("pre-#55
plans", "a session paused before #53", "the pre-#41 sets") are restated as the
feature itself (plans without declared checkpoints, sessions from before
suspension fields, the planning-only sets), so the migration boundaries stay
exact. Every function, contract flag, file, test pin and tripwire stays, and
the tripwire names cited by the cross-cutting charter are unchanged.
